subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) Many diseases are (i) environment pollution rising at (b) Experts believe that (ii) many more diseases SSC English it is due to (c) Pollution appears to (iii) an alarming rate be (d) Today city people (iv) affliction by pollution suffer from (e) Adulterated food is (v) greater in urban areas also responsible (vi) for affection human beings (vii) rural societies too
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (iii) Many diseases are rising at an alarming rate. (b) + (i) Experts believe that it is due to environment pollution. (c) + (v) Pollution appears to be greater in urban areas. (d) + (ii) Today city people suffer from many more diseases. (e) + (vi) Adulterated food is also responsible for affecting human beings.
